_comment: Questions for the SQL assistant eval (EMBEDDED-LLM-SCOPE.md, lot 0), over fixture.json. A case scores on execution: the reference's rows must each be found, as a multiset of values, in a distinct row of the generated result, with the same row count. Column names and order do not count; representation does (an epoch second is not a timestamp). AssistantEvalDatasetTest holds every reference to running, every broken statement to a planner refusal.

cases.question: List the ids and amounts of FURNITURE orders in demo.orders.1.received
cases.reference: SELECT id, amount FROM demo_orders_1_received WHERE type = 'FURNITURE'

cases.question: Which orders in demo.orders.1.received have an amount above 500?
cases.reference: SELECT id, amount FROM demo_orders_1_received WHERE amount > 500

cases.question: Show the id and name of the customers in the PREMIUM segment (demo.customers)
cases.reference: SELECT customer_id, name FROM demo_customers WHERE segment = 'PREMIUM'

cases.question: Which orders were rejected in demo.orders.2.validated, and for what reason?
cases.reference: SELECT id, reason FROM demo_orders_2_validated WHERE state = 'REJECTED'

cases.question: Sensor id and temperature of the readings whose status is ALERT in demo.iot.sensors
cases.reference: SELECT sensor_id, temperature FROM demo_iot_sensors WHERE status = 'ALERT'

cases.question: Quels capteurs du site PARIS-DC1 ont relevé plus de 26 degrés, et quelle température ? (demo.iot.sensors)
cases.reference: SELECT sensor_id, temperature FROM demo_iot_sensors WHERE site = 'PARIS-DC1' AND temperature > 26

cases.question: Payment references and amounts of the payments authorized for less than 10 EUR (demo.payments.authorized)
cases.reference: SELECT paymentRef, amount FROM demo_payments_authorized WHERE amount < 10

cases.question: Which shipments were dispatched from hub CDG? (demo.shipments.dispatched)
cases.reference: SELECT shipmentRef FROM demo_shipments_dispatched WHERE hub = 'CDG'

cases.question: Les identifiants des commandes du client C-001 dans demo.orders.1.received
cases.reference: SELECT id FROM demo_orders_1_received WHERE customer_id = 'C-001'

cases.question: Ids and names of the customers located in France or Germany (country codes FR and DE) in demo.customers
cases.reference: SELECT customer_id, name FROM demo_customers WHERE country IN ('FR', 'DE')

cases.question: How many orders per type in demo.orders.1.received?
cases.reference: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM demo_orders_1_received GROUP BY type

cases.question: Total order amount per customer id in demo.orders.1.received
cases.reference: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM demo_orders_1_received GROUP BY customer_id

cases.question: How many distinct order ids are there in demo.orders.1.received?
cases.reference: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS orders FROM demo_orders_1_received

cases.question: Average temperature per site in demo.iot.sensors
cases.reference: SELECT site, AVG(temperature) AS avg_temperature FROM demo_iot_sensors GROUP BY site

cases.question: Maximum humidity per sensor in demo.iot.sensors
cases.reference: SELECT sensor_id, MAX(humidity) AS max_humidity FROM demo_iot_sensors GROUP BY sensor_id

cases.question: What is the total amount of the captured payments in demo.payments.captured?
cases.reference: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM demo_payments_captured

cases.question: Number of customer records per segment in demo.customers
cases.reference: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS records FROM demo_customers GROUP BY segment

cases.question: Which order ids appear more than once in demo.orders.1.received, and how many times?
cases.reference: SELECT id, COUNT(*) AS occurrences FROM demo_orders_1_received GROUP BY id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

cases.question: Number of ALERT readings per site in demo.iot.sensors
cases.reference: SELECT site, COUNT(*) AS alerts FROM demo_iot_sensors WHERE status = 'ALERT' GROUP BY site

cases.question: Combien de paiements par fournisseur (provider) dans demo.payments.authorized ?
cases.reference: SELECT provider, COUNT(*) AS payments FROM demo_payments_authorized GROUP BY provider

cases.question: Minimum and maximum order amount per type in demo.orders.1.received
cases.reference: SELECT type, MIN(amount) AS min_amount, MAX(amount) AS max_amount FROM demo_orders_1_received GROUP BY type

cases.question: Average amount of the FOOD orders in demo.orders.1.received
cases.reference: SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM demo_orders_1_received WHERE type = 'FOOD'

cases.question: Number of readings per 30-minute bucket in demo.iot.sensors; event_time is in epoch seconds and the bucket should be returned as the epoch second it starts at
cases.reference: SELECT event_time / 1800 * 1800 AS bucket_start, COUNT(*) AS readings FROM demo_iot_sensors GROUP BY event_time / 1800 * 1800

cases.question: Average temperature per hour in demo.iot.sensors; event_time is in epoch seconds, return the hour start as epoch seconds
cases.reference: SELECT event_time / 3600 * 3600 AS hour_start, AVG(temperature) AS avg_temperature FROM demo_iot_sensors GROUP BY event_time / 3600 * 3600

cases.question: Maximum temperature per site and per hour in demo.iot.sensors (event_time in epoch seconds, hour start as epoch seconds)
cases.reference: SELECT site, event_time / 3600 * 3600 AS hour_start, MAX(temperature) AS max_temperature FROM demo_iot_sensors GROUP BY site, event_time / 3600 * 3600

cases.question: Number of customer records per one-minute tumbling window of event_time in demo.customers
cases.reference: SELECT window_start, COUNT(*) AS records FROM TABLE(TUMBLE(TABLE demo_customers, DESCRIPTOR(event_time), INTERVAL '1' MINUTE)) GROUP BY window_start, window_end

cases.question: For each order in demo.orders.1.received, show the order id and the customer name from demo.customers
cases.reference: SELECT r.id, c.name FROM demo_orders_1_received r JOIN demo_customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id

cases.question: Which order ids of demo.orders.1.received appear in demo.orders.2.validated with the state VALIDATED?
cases.reference: SELECT DISTINCT r.id FROM demo_orders_1_received r JOIN demo_orders_2_validated v ON r.id = v.id WHERE v.state = 'VALIDATED'

cases.question: For each payment, its reference with its authorization event_time (demo.payments.authorized) and its capture event_time (demo.payments.captured)
cases.reference: SELECT a.paymentRef, a.event_time AS authorized_at, c.event_time AS captured_at FROM demo_payments_authorized a JOIN demo_payments_captured c ON a.paymentRef = c.paymentRef

cases.question: For each shipment, its reference, the hub it was dispatched from (demo.shipments.dispatched) and who signed for it (demo.shipments.delivered)
cases.reference: SELECT d.shipmentRef, d.hub, v.signed_by FROM demo_shipments_dispatched d JOIN demo_shipments_delivered v ON d.shipmentRef = v.shipmentRef

cases.question: Total order amount per customer name, joining demo.orders.1.received with demo.customers
cases.reference: SELECT c.name, SUM(r.amount) AS total FROM demo_orders_1_received r JOIN demo_customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.name

cases.question: Ids of the orders in demo.orders.1.received placed by customers of the VIP segment (demo.customers)
cases.reference: SELECT r.id FROM demo_orders_1_received r JOIN demo_customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'VIP'

cases.question: For each payment reference, the delay in seconds between its authorization (demo.payments.authorized) and its capture (demo.payments.captured); event_time is in epoch seconds
cases.reference: SELECT a.paymentRef, c.event_time - a.event_time AS delay_seconds FROM demo_payments_authorized a JOIN demo_payments_captured c ON a.paymentRef = c.paymentRef

cases.question: Ids of the orders of demo.orders.1.received that have no row in demo.orders.2.validated
cases.reference: SELECT r.id FROM demo_orders_1_received r LEFT JOIN demo_orders_2_validated v ON r.id = v.id WHERE v.id IS NULL

cases.question: Number of orders received of type FOOD
cases.reference: SELECT COUNT(*) AS metric_value FROM demo_orders_1_received WHERE type = 'FOOD'

cases.question: Average temperature across all sensors
cases.reference: SELECT AVG(temperature) AS metric_value FROM demo_iot_sensors

cases.question: Total amount of the captured payments
cases.reference: SELECT SUM(amount) AS metric_value FROM demo_payments_captured

cases.question: Number of sensor readings in ALERT status
cases.reference: SELECT COUNT(*) AS metric_value FROM demo_iot_sensors WHERE status = 'ALERT'

cases.question: Number of distinct customers that placed an order
cases.reference: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS metric_value FROM demo_orders_1_received

cases.question: Highest humidity measured
cases.reference: SELECT MAX(humidity) AS metric_value FROM demo_iot_sensors
